name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
summary: A lying triceps extension where the dumbbells lower toward the sides of the head. It isolates the triceps and is easy to do on a bench, sofa edge or the floor.
setup: Lie on your back on the floor or a bench with feet flat. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral (palms facing in) grip.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your shoulder blades pulled back.
execution: Bend only at the elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the triceps, keeping control.
Extend your elbows to return to the top, squeezing the triceps.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare out: keep them pointing at the ceiling and shoulder-width apart.
Letting the upper arms drift back, turning it into a pullover: keep them vertical.
Using too much weight: start light and keep control, because the weights pass close to the head.
Bending the wrists: keep them neutral and aligned with the forearms.
